authentication.vendor_assets_scope: Large vendor assets are referenced by their frozen vendor manifest, not duplicated or reverified by this helper.

validity.scope: Valid no-model apparatus diagnostic only. This is not a scored recovery or scientific-release admission.

independent_replay.timing_boundary_method: linear interpolation of adjacent fresh wall/sim samples

phase_diagnostics.phase_accounting: Nested durations are inclusive and overlap; do not sum parent and child phases. Bounded top rows are selected diagnostics, not a continuous CPU/scheduler trace.
interpretation: Nested intervals are inclusive; aggregate or parent/child durations must not be summed.
The longest bridge interval is 84.4864 ms; its retained recorder.image child is 69.6895 ms and contained commit is 56.3607 ms. The latter two report zero CPU in this interval.

Largest SQLite commit and execute calls are 59.5638 ms and 58.7029 ms with zero recorded thread/process CPU. They localize waiting/descheduling inside native calls, not a particular disk, VFS, external process or database mechanism.

The maximum-lag neighborhood contains 67.6585 ms housekeeping including 11.9015 ms protected-state and 52.2279 ms public-state fsync, followed by roughly 30.385 ms until the next after-work timing sample. The bounded top-phase store does not retain every child of that next tick.

Lock acquisition/release maxima are below 0.350 ms; RGB/depth encoding maxima are 10.5423/16.2086 ms. This run does not support lock-contention or an expensive encoder as the dominant near-limit stalls.
Evaluator maximum is 1.4517 ms with no retained evaluator interval above 5 ms.
CPU clocks have coarse quantization; zero CPU is a measured counter delta and does not mean literally no instructions executed.

native_job_receipt.scope: Dedicated native host process commitment; no WSL/model-process limit and no new watchdog.
native_job_receipt.membership_scope: Job membership/limit persists for this bounded host process lifetime; only our job handle closes.

collector.interpretation: No automatic cyclic collection overlapped measured physics. The retained generation-0 collection starts after the final timing sample and restoration; its 183.145 ms wall / 156.25 ms CPU belongs to cleanup.

external_storage_guard.scope: Timestamp overlap is correlation only; these scans do not identify a cause of native-call or fsync waits.

comparison_with_probe_003.source_delta_interpretation: Production delta adds bridge/recorder instrumentation and host wiring only. The host_probe.py delta adds the recorder-stall-localization purpose choice. The original recorder, evaluator, GC policy, memory policy, SQLite settings, synchronization and durability are unchanged.
comparison_with_probe_003.causal_limit: A passing longer run does not demonstrate that instrumentation fixed the prior stall. Probe 003 lacks the new nested recorder phases; SQLite attribution for its terminal bridge delay remains unresolved. No controlled causal effect or failure-rate estimate is established.

conclusion.demonstrated: The declared 900-second no-model diagnostic completed and passed all unchanged timing, scheduling and resource gates. Low-CPU native SQLite and journal fsync waits remain observable, with a maximum lag margin of 4.8521 ms.
remaining_uncertainties: Why SQLite and journal fsync waits cluster near 534-555 seconds in this run.
Whether waits arise from disk latency, filesystem/VFS effects, external contention, native synchronization, descheduling or a combination.
Whether PERSIST would improve latency without shifting stalls or violating peak-space accounting.
Whether the unchanged strict gates hold under model load; the no-model result cannot establish this.
Baseline private commitment has only 12.9414 MiB headroom below the existing 1 GiB admission limit; this run passes but does not establish headroom for every future host.

next_step.recommendation: Before spending model qualification quota, perform a bounded prospective PERSIST-versus-DELETE FULL feasibility/parity/peak-space evaluation. Keep probe 004 valid and preserve all thresholds. Do not adopt a new journal mode from this passing diagnostic alone.
next_step.reason: Repeated native SQLite waits are now directly localized, and observed lag headroom is small; this supports a focused infrastructure comparison. Independent journal fsync waits also contribute, so PERSIST is not a demonstrated complete repair.
requirements: Keep FULL durability, one connection, the same lock, exact encoded payloads, retention/quota rules, commit-before-return and commit-before-observation ordering.
Prove conservative rollback-journal peak and residual coverage within unchanged total storage/reserve caps; current database-page guard and journal_size_limit alone do not establish this.
Verify mode/readback, failure and interrupted-transaction behavior, clean finalization and current Reader compatibility in temporary fixtures.
Any adopted change requires its own frozen revision and fresh declared full-duration, native, boundary and model qualification before campaign admission.
next_step.prohibited_inferences: No threshold relaxation, discarded historical failure, retroactive validity change, durability reduction, unbounded background writer or PERSIST benefit claim.
